result:
The round 168 task (V-3c-4b) is implemented. It still needs C's checks in the browser, and I am not claiming any C row.

**What changed:** only class strings, in 7 granted paths. No text, aria, handlers or sizes changed.
- **`ArrangementLane.tsx`:**
  - Lane Mute and Solo lose their outline and get the 5 % fill with 8 % hover and 12 % press, an 8 px radius and the 180 ms transition.
  - When on, they keep their on colour while hovered or pressed.
  - Both video-import buttons now look like Export: brand border and text, plus the 5 % fill. The old brand hover tint is gone.
  - Fold, name and pan reset get the 8 px radius only.
- **`ArrangementGroupHeader.tsx`:** the same treatment for group Mute and Solo. The mixed Solo look is unchanged, as B ruled. Fold, name and the rename field get 8 px only.
- **Tests:** new LSU7 and UM11 checks, plus one value changed in TH10 in `studio-theme-obsidian.test.tsx`.
- **Docs:** doc 136 is marked Completed. New doc 137 includes the test counts and mutation results.

**Checks I ran:**
- Baseline before editing: 249/249 on the 12 targeted test files. After editing: 251/251.
- `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` both pass. Lint's warnings were already there, and none are in the changed files. Biome on the 5 code and test files is clean.
- All 7 mutations (m199–m205) made the expected tests fail. m203 failed both UM11 and TH10. Each mutation was undone and the file hash checked against the edited version.
- The 980 frozen files still match, and the protected files are unchanged against `1fef377`.
- `git status` shows only the 6 granted files as modified plus the new doc 137.
- Not run, per the speed rules: the full test suite, `npm run verify`, the build, e2e and every browser check.

**Code review:** the code-reviewer subagent scored it 9/10 with nothing Critical, High or Medium. I applied three of its small suggestions to tighten LSU7 and UM11, then re-ran the tests and checks.

**Architecture note for B:** this round adds 5 more copies of the shared button-surface classes. The reviewer proposes one shared constant after V-3c-4c, together with dropping the `!` suffixes. That is a proposal only; I left it out of this round.

**Known trade-offs from the spec (not bugs):**
- The new fill is very faint against its background, about 1.12–1.13:1.
- Buttons that are already on show no change when hovered (Q-R167-ON-HOVER).
- The selected track name and the small pan readout get rounder ends, which Saba may veto.

The full report is in `a-round-168.md`, with evidence in `a-round-168-result.json` and `a-round-168/` (end hashes, diff patch, mutation results).
